nutrition_process_effects.summary: Pharmacologic GLP-1 RAs increase satiety, slow gastric emptying (class effect, agent/dose/time dependent), and reduce energy intake; product bias is protein-first meals and non-judgmental smaller volume — not a calorie prescription.

effects.description: Appetite/satiety signaling shifted — smaller plates often sufficient
effects.product_bias: normalize smaller intake; avoid shaming low volume

effects.description: Delayed gastric emptying common (varies by agent and duration of therapy)
effects.product_bias: optional narrative on meal pace; not a full GI kinetic model

effects.product_bias: C-8 Protein Priority = #1; density axis matters more when calories drop

support: Protein density and meal quality still matter while intake is lower

refuse: This meal replaces your GLP-1 medication
Stop your prescription based on food score

bullets: GLP-1 receptor agonists are established for T2D and/or chronic weight management depending on agent/label; dual GIP/GLP-1 (tirzepatide) is related but not identical.
Mechanisms relevant to food: central appetite effects + delayed gastric emptying (often attenuates somewhat with ongoing use for some agents) + reduced ad libitum energy intake in trials.

Nutrition practice themes in literature/clinical guidance discussions: prioritize protein when total intake falls; manage GI symptoms; resistance training + protein for lean mass during weight loss; do not treat the drug as a free pass for UPF.
Food-is-medicine coaching remains complementary — never a substitute for the prescribing clinician.
